zas gos longs spyod kyi phongs pa med pa yid bzhin du 'byor pa dang*/ de dag gis kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang*/ 'gro ba mang po la phan thogs pa'i phrin las mdzod/ rig pa 'dzin pa 'dis dam pa'i chos tshul bzhin bsgrub pa la bar chad byed pa'i 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad/ srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams kyis mi 'dul ba med pas/ mngon spyod kyi las kyis tshar bcad nas bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod/ mdor na sbyin bdag gam rig pa 'dzin pa 'di yi lus la grib ma bzhin du bzhugs nas/ ci srid sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba ba'i phrin las mdzod cig /de nas me tog spyi bor bzhag la/ mdun gyi mgon po'i sku las/ de 'dra ba'i mgon po'i sku mthe bong gi tshad tsam dpag tu med pa 'phros/ slob ma'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ snying gar thim pas/ slob ma'i snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad du gyur pa'i lte bar/ mgon po 'bral med du bzhugs pa'i pad+ma kha zum pa'i steng du rdo rje phyed pas rgyas btab par bsam/ de ltar bsgoms pas 'di'i 'khor gyi gnod pa dang*/ srung ma 'di'i sgo nas gzhan gyi byad byas pa rnams kyis mi tshugs pa'i gdams ngag dam pa yin/ de ltar rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas/ da rjes kyi bya ba mi 'bral bar bya ba la/ sgrub pa pos chos skyong dang mi 'bral ba'i ched du/ khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung*/ bye brag tu sngags zhus pa'i bla ma la gus par bya/ khyad par chos skyong 'di zhus pa'i bla ma dang chos rgyud la dad cing gus par bya/ de'i yan lag tu mgon po la dus rgyun du gtor ma 'bul ba'am/ de ma grub na zla ba byung ngo cog gi nyi shu dgu la gtor ma dbul bar mdzod/ de ltar byas pas chos skyong rang sgrub pa po dang mi 'bral bar shugs las mdzad pa yin no// de bzhin du gsang bar gdams pa yang*/

spyir gsang sngags kyi chos thams cad gsang nas nyams su len dgos pa ltar/ srung ma 'di lta bu'i bsnyen sgrub byed pa dang*/ rjes gnang ston tshul la sogs pa yang dam tshig dang mi ldan pa gzhan la gsang dgos pa yin/ de rnams tshul bzhin du nyams su blangs snyam pa'i bsams pas/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// zhes pas dam tshig dang sdom pa bsdus te khas blangs par mos pa mdzod/ de dag gis dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa'i rjes su gnang ba thun mong ma yin pa lha brgyad du grags pa'i rjes su gnang ba thob par byas pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal dbul bar mdzod/ ces brjod la maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug cing*/ lus longs spyod thams cad kyang yon du phul bas cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pa mdzod la/ 'di'i rjes zlos gsungs shig deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// sogs lan gsum brjod du gzhug go /de rnams kyis nag po chen po'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa grub par byas pas/ rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po sgrub par mdzod cig byas la btang ngo*// de nas gtor ma sa gtsang sar dor ba sogs rjes kyi bya ba gtor chog bzhin bya'o// nag po chen po'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa bya tshul/ bklags pas don grub pa'i 'di su rung rung la bstan par mi bya'o// bstan pa la phan thogs par gyur cig/ //

༄// dpal sa skya'i bka' srung rnams kyi gtor ma'i cho ga dgra las rnam par rgyal ba bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal sa skya'i bka' srung rnams kyi gtor ma'i cho ga dgra las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal kye rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// dpa' bo gang zhig dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// phun tshogs dngos grub mtha' dag nyer stsol zhing*// bar chad bdud kyi dgra las rgyal byed pa'i// khyab bdag nag po che la gus btud nas// thub bstan dri med phyogs bcur rgyas phyir dang*// tshe dang dpal 'byor bsod nams spel ba dang*// mi mthun phyogs kun zhi bar bya phyir du// gtor ma'i cho ga gzhung bzhin bshad kyis nyon// 'dir bsnyen pa las su rung ba'i rnal 'byor pas// srung ma'i dbang po rnams la gtor ma dbul bar bya ba la/ cho ga sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum gyi dang po ni/ gnas dben par srung ma rnams kyi bris sku dang*/ rten bshams pa'i mdun du/ stegs bu ras bzang po dang*/ dar zab kyis brgyan pa'i steng du/ 'bru sna tshogs kyis gcal du bkram/ de'i steng du gser dngul gyi snod dam/ zangs gzhong ngam/ ma 'byor na shing gzhong ngam/ rdza las kyang rung ste/ bse'i snod du ni mi bya'o// snod de rnams su dang po 'das pa'i gtor ma/ gnyis pa nag po chen po/ gsum pa dpal lha mo/ bzhi pa lcags kyi snod dam/ sngar smos pa'i snod du/ mgon po gdong bzhi pa/ lnga pa pu tra ming sring*/ drug pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ bdun pa dgon gnas kyi gzhi bdag dbang thob pa yod na bsham/ med na 'dir bsham du mi rung*/ de thams cad kyang zan bzang po la/ 'bras dang gro la sogs pa'i 'bru sna tshogs bsres pas snying po zlum po pad+ma'i snying po ltar zlum zhing rtse mo cung zad rno bar byas pa'i mthar/ mtheb skyu pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i tshul du bskor bar bya bar rdo rje mchu'i dam tshig gi gzungs las bshad cing*/

gru gsum sogs su bya ba chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos bkag pas mi bya'o// bla ma kun dga' grags kyi lag len la/ 'das gtor mkha' 'gro spyi/ gzhi bdag gsum zlum po/ mgon po dang lha mo gnyis kyi rtsa ba gsum gnyis man zlum po/ stod sum cha zur gsum mi rno ba/ gdong bzhi pa de dang 'dra ba la snying po'i phyogs bzhir yum bzhi'i bshos bu zur gsum mi rno ba bzhi bya/ pu tra la snying po gru bzhi pa/ rtse mo rim gyis phra bar byas pa la/ phyogs bzhi nas gru gsum pa mnyam po bzhi sbyar bas zur brgyad du byas pa la/ gta' gtor zur brgyad pa zer bas de ltar bya gsung ngo*// gtor ma thams cad la mar dang*/ sbrang rtsi dang*/ thud dang*/ bu ram sogs zas bzang dgu sna tshogs pa dang*/ gsad pa ma yin pa'i sha btsos pa sna tshogs pa dang*/ bye brag tu mgon po dang lha mo la kha na ma tho ba med pa'i sha sna tshogs mang du btsos pa/ bag zan dang lhan cig byas pa dzam+bu ti ka'i mchod pa mang du brgyan/ gzhan yang la du dang*/ la phug dang*/ sgog btsong dang*/ chang sna tshogs pa dang bcas par bsham/ de dag la dar sna tshogs kyi gur ram/ ba dan rgyan du mas spras pa la/ mu tig dang*/ gser g.yu dang*/ byi ru la sogs pa rin po che du mas spras pa gzugs/ de rnams kyi mdun du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang*/ khyad par mgon po la/ yungs kar/ gu gul/ dug tshil chen rnams bsres pa'i bdug spos bsham/ gzhan yang nang mchod/ rdo rje dril bu sogs/ nye bar mkho ba thams cad tshang bar bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ dpal kye rdo rje'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar rdzogs par byas la/ gtor ma dang po 'das pa'i lha la cho ga bzhin dbul/ de nas mgon po lcam dral gyi gtor ma gnyis la/ lag pa g.yon pa bstan te/ oṃ zhes brjod pas stong bar bsam/ g.yas pa bstan te/ aḥzhes brjod pas thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/

dpral ba rang la bstan pa dang*/ gnyis ka bstan te hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan te/ ho zhes brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od 'phros gdug pa thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje nag po chen po cher 'bar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas kyis gri gug g.yon pas thod pa thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis car gyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gyi gaṇ+ḍi bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa dang*/ lhab lhub kyis bklubs pa/ mi'u thung gel pa'i 'dug stangs kyis ro'i steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su bya nag g.yon na khyi nag rgyab na lcags spyang*/ mdun na mi nag steng na nam mkha' lding gi sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro ba/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du ṭaṃ las e ka dza ṭi sku mdog sngon mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bzas stod g.yogs pa stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ral pa lan bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba/ khro mo'i rnam pa can/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du trag las khrag gis rgya mtsho'i nang du/ bh+yo las dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa/ sku mdog sngon nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas kyi dang po ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/

g.yon gyi dang po na mdung*/ gnyis pa rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing*/ ba glang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs can/ klu'i dbang pos ska rags bcings pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul dang*/ g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/ sku la khrag gi thig le dang*/ zhag gi zo ris dang*/ thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ shin tu rid pa lte ba'i thad nas nyi zla 'char ba/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na hūm̐ dang bh+yo'i sgra sgrogs pa/ lcam dral gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin pa āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas mgon po dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo spyan drangs par mos la/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba mgon po'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcas te// mdzub po g.yab pa'am rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mgon po kun gshegs gdan las bzhengs// da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus// gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang*// shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir// gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol// oṃ shrī ma hā kā la e h+ye hi/ zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar ba lha mo'i dam tshig phyag rgya g.yab pa'am/ dril bu'i sgras/ lha mo 'dir gshegs sogs dang*/ ma hā kā lī de wī e h+ye his spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dbyer med du bstim/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan dbul/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas shap+da'i bar gyis mgon po mchod la/ yang*/ oṃ ma hā kā lī de wī gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis lha mo la mchod nas/ mgon po'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcas la/

spyi bor bzhag par mos te/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ sa ma ya sma ra/ sa ma ya ma ti kra ma/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ces pas mgon po dam la bzhag yang lha mo'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcas la spyi bor bzhag par bsam ste/ oṃ ma hā kā lī de wī/ sa ma ya sma ra sogs kyis lha mo dam la bzhag bsdu na de tsam gyis chog la/ spro na bka' bsgo ste/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba dang*/ bdag gis lam sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dor bar mdzad du gsol// gal te zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul du ma 'tshal na/ gang la gang 'tsham pa'i chad pas bcad pa dang*/ bskrad cing gzir ba dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ bsdigs shing spa bkong bar mdzad du gsol/ mdor na chos sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub cing*/ bstan pa dang*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa kun dar zhing rgyas par mdzod/ ces pas phrin las bcol/ de nas mgon po la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ/ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā di ye swā hā/ zhes lnga'am bdun dang*/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na u pa hā ri ṇi/ e ṣa a pash+tsi ma kā lo/ a yaṃ i daṃ rat+na tra ya/ a pa kā ri ṇaṃ/ ya di pra tī dzñā sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭaṃ kha kha/

khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ grih+ṇa grih+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na/ mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces rtsa sngags lan gsum brjod la/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas gtor ma phul/ de bzhin du lha mo la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lī de wī sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo/ zhes sogs/ gsum mam/ bdun gyis phul nas gong ltar mchod/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ zhes mgon po'i snying po dang*/ oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha/ bad+dhot+sī kā ma la rak+ṣa sī hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ zhes lha mo'i snying pos nang mchod gtor/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ gi yi ge las byung ba'i// nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa// zhal gcig mdog sngon cher 'bar zhing*// zangs gri thod pa bsnams la bstod// mgo bo'i phreng bas do shal byas// mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs su rung*// bong thung gzi brjid chen po ste// zhal dmar rnam par g.yo la bstod// slob dpon la rtag sdang ba dang*// gang zhig dkon mchog gsum la gnod// sems can sna tshogs gsod pa rnams// za byed nag po che la bstod// ces bstod cing*/ dpal ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang*// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa'i// rgya chen sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bde gshegs bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*// dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang cher mtho zhing*// bstan 'dzin thams cad sku tshe legs brtan nas// rnam dkar phrin las rgyas par mdzad du gsol// khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// 'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*// tshe dang blo gros bsod rnams rab rgyas nas// thos bsam sgrub pa 'phel bar mdzad du gsol// zhes pas phrin las bcol/ de nas lha mo la/ bh+yo rgya mtsho'i klong nas me 'bar khyod// mtsho rnams skems par nus ma ste// bud med thams cad zhi mdzad phyir// lha chen sku yi phyed du bzhag

/rdzong dang dka' bzlog nag mo ste// lha dang lha min phyag byas ma// mi nad gang yin khyod ming shes// de la 'jigs pa med par mdzad// gshin rje'i lcam mo bdud kyi yum// 'dod khams dbang phyug ma la bstod// ces pas bstod la/ dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// phyi nang gsang ba ces sogs sngar ltar sbyar ro// de nas bzlas pa byed par 'dod na/ sngar gyi bdug spos de bsreg cing*/ yi dam gyi lha'i sngags phreng skor gcig tsam bzlas pa'i rjes su/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags 'od zer dang bcas pa 'phros/ mdun gyi mgon po 'khor bcas kyi thugs kar phog pas de dag gi rgyud bskul te gang bsgo ba nyan par bsams la/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa yi ge bdun ma dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ ces pa yi ge bcu gnyis pa dang*/ rtsa sngags rnams ci nus par bzlas/ de bzhin du lha mo la dmigs pa gtad la snying po bzlas nas mthar mchod pas mchod/ bstod pa bya/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo// 'di ni lcam dral sbag sgrub kyi lugs ltar bkod pa yin/ rkyang sgrub so sor byed na/ gtor ma gnyis pa byin gyis brlab/ mgon po bskyed/ spyan drangs la bstim/ oṃ ma hā kā la sa ma ya sma ra sogs gsum gyis dam la bzhag mchod pas mchod/ oṃ ma hā kā lā ya na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ gzungs ring lan gsum gyis gtor ma dbul mchod pa dang mgon po nyid kyi bstod pa sngags gsum bzlas pa rnams sngar bzhin bya ste/ pho rkyang du sgrub pa'i lugs so// de bzhin du gtor ma gsum pa byin gyis brlab/ mdun du pad nyi'i steng du ṭaṃ las e ka dza ṭi bskyed/ de'i lto ba'am/ bla ma gong mas snying gar bskyed par bshad pas de bzhin bya/ spyan drangs/ dam la bzhag gtor ma dbul/ bstod pa bya ba sogs lha mo rkyang pa'i tshul du bya/ bzlas pa'i tshe sngar gyi dmigs pa dang ldan pas/

oṃ ro ru sogs dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ shri ya de wī kā lī kā lī hūm̐ bh+yo/ zhes dang bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ ma hā kā lī de wī sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa dang*/ lha mo nyid kyi bstod pa sogs sngar ltar bya ste/ mo rkyang du sgrub pa'i lugs so// de ltar so sor cho ga bya mi nus pa'am/ nus kyang lha mo rtsub par gyur na/ phyogs gcig tu gtor ma dbul zhing bzlas pa byed pa man ngag ste/ gong sbag sgrub tu bshad pa bltar ro// de nas gur las bshad pa'i mgon po dang gzungs las bshad pa'i lha mo dgos pa'i dbang gis lhan cig tu sgrub pa la lcam dral sgrub pa zhes pa yin gyi/ srung ma 'di gnyis 'jig rten pa'i ming sring ngam yab yum ltar ni ma yin no// de nas gtor ma bzhi pa mgon po gdong bzhi pa la 'bul ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdun du paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan par yongs su gyur pa las nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa/ rtsa zhal gnyis brtsegs ma nag po/ g.yas g.yon gnyis ljang nag phyag bzhi'i g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og mas ral gri dang g.yon 'og mas rus phreng 'phyar thabs su mdzad pa/ skra kham pa gyen du brdzes shing spyan gsum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing mchu 'phyang ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dang rus pa dang sbrul gyis brgyan zhing zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ drag la rngam pa'i cha lugs can/ ngag tu ha ha dang*/ hūm̐ hūm̐ dang*/ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ gi sgra sgrogs par bsam/ de'i g.yas su g.yung mo nag mo/ g.yon du gtum mo ljang gu/ mdun du srin po dmar mo/ rgyab tu siṃ ga lī ma ser nag bzhi ga'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/

gcer bu rgyan med pa rab tu grims shing khros pa'i cha lugs can/ g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum bzhengs pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par aḥ thugs kar hūm̐ bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ ti se bsil ba'i tshal/ po ta la/ ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod nas/ ye shes pa spyan drangs par mos la/ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru// gtum po khyod kyis ji ltar khas blangs bzhin// phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren na// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol// oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la/ ra tṛ ta/ ḍom+bī nī/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ rak+kha sī/ siṃ ga lī/ de wī sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye his zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par bstim/ pad+ma ka ma lā s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul/ sa pa ri wā ra'i rjes su gṛh+ṇa daṃ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag par mos la/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la/ bi kā la ra tṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍom+bi nī tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ rak+kha sī/ siṃ gha lī/ de wī sa ma ya/ sma ra nas phrin las bcol ba'i bar dang*/ de'i rjes su/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta la sogs pa btags la sngar bzhin gtor ma dbul/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ gong gi sngags gsum gyi rjes su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pas nang mchod phul la/ hūm̐ mi rtog dbyings las thugs rje'i skur bzhengs shig /'byung ba gur chen brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas nas// bde gshegs bka' yi srung ma dam tshig can// rdo rje nag po chen po dbyings las bzhengs// dpal ldan dbang ldan srid gsum dbang bsgyur zhing*// mche ba gtsigs shing mchu 'phyang shugs che ba// sgra sgrogs dril bu'i phreng bas brgyan pa yi// gdong bzhi'i gdan khyod ti se'i zhing skyong mdzad// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan snga ru// bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i// nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa// yum chen sring mo bzhi dang bcas// sha chen zan dang me tog spos// chang phud sha khrag dag gis mchod// rgyal ba'i bstan pa skyong ba dang*// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// ces pas bstod/

de nas bzlas pa byed na sngar gyi dmigs pa dang ldan pas/ gur mgon gyi sngags thung phreng skor gcig tsam gyi rjes su/ 'di yi sngags thung gtso bor bzlas rjes su sngags ring kyang bzlas te/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kaṭ+ṭa/ ka ra la/ laṃ bi ta o ṭha/ lam+bā ka be ka lam+ba ka bā li/ ra wi ghaṇ+ḍe/ ru tra mā la bi hū re/ ts+tshe da ha ka le/ ha le na ha le/ pim+bi dzā li/ ba me ghun+de dha ri yaṃ ma eṃ/ da hi na karti ka kā ro ṭi bi bhi ṣa ṇa dha eṃ/ bā me shū la pā ṇe/ ha ra dā+o ra na ra sī ra mā la/ pā tā le/ k+ṣiṃ kā ra ka la/ ma hā po ṭa le/ ma hā kā la/ shrī ka pī la/ ke la saṃ k+ṣe ṭa pā la/ hā hā kā re/ hūm̐ hūm̐ kā re/ purba bhā ṣa bhi uṃ/ dzau dzan+ti/ maṃ sa bhan+ta/ phul+la dhū pa/ i kā ha ba li dzi gha ha/ da sha di ka ut+ta ra wu ri/ ḍom+bi nī tsaṇ+ḍa li rak+kha si siṃ gha lī de wī/ ha na ha na/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ma ra ma ra/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ/ li hi ba liṃ de hi sid+dhi/ bi kā la sha trūṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas la/ mchod bstod 'dod don zhu ba sogs bya'o// lnga pa las mkhan pu tra ming sring la 'bul te/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas ya dang*/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas m+maṃ mdun du spros pas/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sngar gyi ya las nag po gnod sbyin sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gyon zhing gser gyi rna cha can/ de'i g.yon du m+maṃ las nag po gnod sbyin zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas gser gyi spu gri/ g.yon klad khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi na bza' gyon zhing*/ byi ru'i lan tshar can/ de gnyis kyi thugs ka nas yab las tri gnyis dang yum las bh+yo gcig mdun du spros pa las/ pu tra ming sring gsum du gyur te/

tri las pu tra nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar gyi aṃ ga rag dang*/ dar nag gi na bzas brgyan pa/ tri las bha ṭa nag po stag slog can g.yas dam shing dang g.yon mi snying 'dzin pa/ bh+yo las sring mo ral gcig ma/ g.yas gser gyi spu gri dang*/ g.yon rgyu ma 'dzin zhing*/ kha nas me 'bar ba/ lnga ka'ang sku mdog mthing nag rab tu khros pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ rus pa'i phreng ba dang*/ mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal gyis brgyan pa/ rngam zhing 'khrugs pas gdugs pa can tshar gcod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ gzhan yang g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa brgya/ g.yon gyi ru 'dren pa dge slong gi gzugs can brgya/ slad kyi rjes su 'brang ba sngags pa nag po brgya/ mdun gyi shul byang 'dren pa bud med nag mo brgya/ gzhan yang dam nyams kyi rjes gcod pa'i bya nag dang*/ khyi nag dang*/ lce spyang dang*/ mi nag la sogs pa pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar bsam/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas las kyi mgon po rnams la bka' sdod pho nya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs par bsams la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ sngags rnams kyi rjes la/ sa ma ya sma ra sogs kyis dam la bzhag bka' bsgo de nas rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ a li a li ma/ dzaḥdzaḥshaṃ shaṃ li shi ded/ a shwa ded/ mo smugs/ pu trī/ a li ma/ dzaḥdzaḥ nag mo sha la rub/ dzaḥdzaḥ oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa la/ a shug me/ ma hūm̐ ma bh+yoḥdzaḥdzaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ bhu dza/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ zhes lnga'am bdun gyis phul zhing*/ phyi mchod dang*/ nang bdud rtsis kyang mchod la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ gnod sbyin yab yum 'jigs pa'i gzugs// rngam zhing 'khrugs pa'i cha lugs kyis// bdud dang dgra bgegs 'joms mdzad pa// bstan srung yab yum che la bstod// mon bu pu tra nag po bskyong*/

men tri'i ga sha sku la gsol// sher shing gseg shang phyag na bsnams// pu tra nag po khyod la bstod// mon bu bha ṭa stag slog bkra// dar gyi ga sha sku la gsol// phyag na dam shing rnon po bsnams// mon bu bha ṭa khyod la bstod// mon mo gser gyi spu gri ma// nag mo chen mo kha 'bar ma// phyag na gser gyi spu gri bsnams// nag mo khyod la bstod pa 'bul// bud med nag mo chen mo brgya// gshegs kyi de ni shul yang 'dren// g.yas kyi phyogs nas ru 'dren pa// skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa brgya// g.yon gyis phyogs nas ru 'dren pa// dge slong nyan thos dgra bcom brgya/ slad kyi rjes 'brang 'jigs rung ba// ban+de nag po phur thogs brgya// 'khor bcas kun la bstod pa 'bul// skabs gsum dag kyang bstod pa 'bul// zhes pas bstod/ las kyi mgon po pho nya 'khor bcas rnams// phyi nang gsang ba sogs sngar ltar sbyar la/ phrin las gzhol lo// bzlas pa byed na/ rang yi dam mam gur mgon gyi nga rgyal gyis/ mgon po'i sngags thung phreng skor gcig tsam dang*/ sngags ring nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bzlas pas gnya' mnan la/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ las mgon rnams la phog pas/ de dag gi rgyud bskul nas/ dga' bzhin du bdag gis bka' nyan par bsam/ 'jig rten pa rnams mos pho bskul ba yin pas dang po oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa la/ a shug me/ ma hūm̐/ ma bh+yoḥ dzaḥdzaḥ zhes mo'i bod pa cha gnyis su bzla/ de nas a li a li ma/ dzaḥdzaḥshaṃ shaṃ li shi ded/ a shwa ded/ mo smugs/ pu trī a li ma/ dzaḥdzaḥ nag mo sha la rub/ dzaḥdzaḥ pho'i bod pa cha gcig bzla/ mthar mchod pa bstod pa/ 'dod don bsgo ba rnams sngar bzhin bya'o// gtor ma drug pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi cho gas dbul/ gtor ma bdun pa gzhi bdag dbang thob cing gsang spyod bstan pas ltung ba mi 'byung ba yin na nang du bsngo ste/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gtor ma bdud rtsir bskyed/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ/ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twā ta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis phul nas/ slar yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis phud gtor la/ gtor ma 'di gnas bdag gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa'i tshogs rnams la 'bul lo// mchod do// 'dren no// sbyin no// gsol lo// bstan pa dar ba dang*/ 'jig rten du bde legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod do// dbang ma thob pa'i gzhi bdag la gtor ma ster na/ sgrub khang gi phyi rol du song la/ gtor ma chang phal pa dang chus sbyang zhing*/ 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes pas bkug a kā ro lan gsum brjod pas tshim par bsams la/ gnas bdag yul bdag 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs kyis bsngo zhing phrin las las bcol la/ dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la bdag cag dpon slob chos sgrub pa'i stong grogs mdzod cig nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas pa gzhan du 'gro bar gyis shig ces brjod la/ khro bo'i sngags dang rol mo drag tu bya zhing gtor ma lam gyis gzhi mdor dor la/ rtsa sngags sogs shib bur bzla zhi nang du 'jug go /de nas rnal 'byor pho mo'i tshogs pa yod na tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya/ med na dpa' bo'i ston mo bya'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor mgron rnams/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ sogs dang*/ badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol ba'am/ spro na sgrub khang gi steng ngam sa gtsang sar gtor ma rnams khyer la/

rol mo dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po ma hā kā la dang*// dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /lcam dral khyod kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i// dur khrod bdag po zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas// snang srid lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas// dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud 'khor dang bcas// mkha' lding bya khyi lcags spyang 'khor dang bcas// pu tra la sogs las mkhan 'khor dang bcas// srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams 'khor dang bcas// 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /dzam bu dh+rī pa'i zhal zas 'di bzhes shig /chang dang phud kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /sngar bcol las kyi gtang rag gnyan po 'bul// da bcol las kyi gsol 'debs gnyan po bzhes// 'khor rnams bsrung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang*// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs// bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnam mang po// thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ bstan pa rgyas pa'i las 'di myur du sgrubs// zhes brjod cing*/ spos dang rol po sna tshogs dang*/ dung gi sgra dang bcas pas gtor ma sa gtsang sar btang*/ mgron rnams gtor mas tshim ste/ dges bzhin du rang rang gi gnas su gshegs par bsam mo// nang du 'ongs la rjes kyis cho ga rnams bya ste/ rgyun du gtor ma 'bul ba'i cho ga'o// gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu gtor ma la brten nas las bsgrub par 'dod na sbyor ba sngar dang 'dra/ 'on kyang 'das gtor ma gtogs pa gzhan rnams la rgyun gtor chung ba re re bsham/ mchod pa dang gtor ma thams cad che zhing bzang ba/ dar 'phan dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis mdzes par byas pa bsham mo// dngos gzhi la/ thun bzhir bsgrubs na/ dgongs thun la kye rdo rje'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya/ thun gzhan gsum la gur gyi mgon po rkyang par bdag bskyed la/ bzlas pa la gtso bor 'bad/

gang ltar yang bdag bskyed rdzogs nas 'das gtor dbul ba dang*/ bzhi bdag gi gtor ma'i bar sngar dang 'dra bar bya/ de nas sngags pa rnams mdun bskyed la phyogs par langs la bla ma dang*/ yi dam srung ma 'khor bcas la phyag 'tshal ba sngon du 'gro bas nyes pa bshags pa'i cho ga chos kyis rgyal po 'phags pas mdzad pa ltar lan gsum gdon pa'i mthar/ sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// bzod par gsol lo/ tshangs par stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas gral la 'khod de bzlas pa bya/ rnal 'byor pa 'ga' zhig gis zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dbul/ sngar so so'i gtor ma'i skabs su bstod pa ma byas na/ 'dir bya ste/ sngon tshe bde gshegs sogs kyis mgon po dang*// til mar gyis bskus sogs kyis lha mo dang*/ dpal ldan dbang ldan sogs kyis mgon po gdong bzhi pa la bstod nas/ slar yang*/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi// thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*// de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams// dpal 'byor gyis brgyan yun ring zhabs bstan mdzod// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la// tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs// don rnams thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// 'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par mdzod// ces pas phrin las gzhol lo// tshig 'di phrin las gzhol ba'i tshig yin gyi/ bkra shis su 'dod pa tshig tsam la yang ma dpyad pa yin no// de nas tshogs kyis 'khor lo sogs byas la/ sngags pa rnams langs nas dbyangs kyi 'dren pa dang bcas pas/ dpal ldan phrin las sogs pu tra bstod cing bskul/ grogs rnams kyis rgyun gtor mtha' nas rim pa bzhin btegs la/ sa gtsang sar khyer te/ der dpon slob thams cad song nas bstab cing phrin las gzhol/ mgron gshegs pa sogs lhag ma sngar bzhin bya/ de ltar thun bzhir bsgrubs nas/

grub pa'i rtags byung na/ gtor ma che ba dang rgyun gtor gnyis ka btang*/ 'das pa'i gtor ma bar chad bsrung ba'i ched du bzhag cho ga lhag ma rnams sngar dang 'dra bar bya ste/ gtor sgrub kyi cho ga'o// de ltar gnas skabs thams cad du lta ba bdag med pa la blo bzhag pa dang*/ byams pa dang snying rje chen po bsgom pa la 'bad par bya'o// gang zhig bstan la srid zhi'i dgra bgegs kyang*// 'joms par nus na gzhan kun lta ci smos// de phyir 'phags yul mkhas mang gis bsten pa'i// srung ma'i mchog 'di gzhan las ches mchog yin// gang 'dir dam tshig can gyi rnal 'byor pas// yang dag brgyud pa'i man ngag ji bzhin du// bzlas dang bsgom pas tshul bzhin bsgrubs gyur na// 'phral dang yun gyi dge legs mtha' dag 'byung*// 'di sbyar dge ba lha dbang rdo rje des// bdud dang dgra bgegs lha min dpung bcom nas// bstan 'dzin lha dbang grong khyer gnas pa rnams// bshad sgrub bdud rtsi'i longs spyod rgyas par bsngo// dpal ldan sa skya'i bka' srung rnams kyis gtor ma'i cho ga dgra las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rje btsun dam pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bka' drin gyis bskyangs pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos/ kun dga'i lo cho 'phrul chen po'i zla ba'i mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus nyi shu dgu la dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi dgon par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bshes gnyen bzang pos bgyis so// //

༄// gtor sgrub kyi man ngag g.yul las rnam rgyal bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// srung ma 'di rnams kyi gtor sgrub byed pa'i man ngag ni 'di yin te/ sgrub pa po la dam sel byung ba dang*/ de'i rkyen gyis srung ma la grib kyis phog nas mi 'dod pa sna tshogs byung na/ de sel ba'i phyir 'khon gcugs sbyong ba'i tshul gyis sgrub pa byed de/ gong 'og rnams sngar bzhin/ 'on kyang bzlas pa'i skabs su/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros mdun kyi mgon po la phog pas mgon po'i thugs kar hūm̐ dkar po bsam/ de las 'od zer dang*/ bdud rtsi dkar po dpag tu med pa byung*/ mgon po'i sku gang thugs ma mnyes pa dang*/ nyams grib dang*/ 'bags bcog thams cad sbyangs/ yang thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po byung*/ bdag gam sbyin bdag sogs kyi spyi bor thim/ des lus kyi nang thams cad khengs pas/ sdig pa dang*/ dam tshig gi nyes pa dang*/ sgrib pa thams cad sbyang bar bsams la/ yi ge brgya pa gtso bor bzla/ thun mjug tu mgon po'i sngags cung zad tsam re bzla/ mthar mgon po'i thugs ka nas 'od dkar po byung bas rang gi spyi bor thim pas nyes pa dag par bsam mo// de bzhin du srung ma gzhan rnams la yang bya'o// sbyin bdag dam tshig can gyi don du byed na mdun du zla ba'i steng du yul de thal mo sbyar phreng ba dang*/ gos dang*/ rgyan dkar pos bklubs par bsams la dmigs pa sngar bzhin bya/ bshags pa'i tshig brjod pa'i skabs su phyag 'tshal zhing 'gyod tshangs byed du gzhug rgyun gtor gtong ba sogs sngar bzhin te/ thun bzhi'i tshul gyis zhag gsum la sogs pa bsgrubs pas/ dngos su khams bde zhing*/ blo chos la dad pa dang*/ rmi lam la nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang*/ khrus byas pa dang*/ gos dkar po gyon pa/ lus las sems can dang*/ ngan skyugs 'thon pa sogs rmi na gtor ma che ba gtang rag gi tshul du phul la rjes sogs sngar bzhin bya'o// yang rang gi rnal 'byor dang*/

mchod gtor sogs chag pa gso ba'am/ ma yin kyang rung ste/ srung ma 'go ba'i don du byed na/ thugs mnyes pa'i tshul gyis bsgrubs te/ gzhan sngar bzhin las bzlas pa'i tshe/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer las dam rdzas dang mchod pa'i yo byad dpag tu med par gyur pa/ nam mkha' dang sa gzhi mtha' dag bkang ste mchod pas mgon po mnyes/ sku lus gzi brjid dang*/ 'od bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur te/ bdag la ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsal bar bsam zhing*/ sngags ring thung rnams bzla/ srung ma gzhan rnams la yang de bzhin du bzlas shing*/ rgyun gtor gtong ba sogs bya/ 'di'i skabs su bstod pa rgyas pa dang*/ slar yang phrin las zhu ba rnams bya/ nub gcig gi tshe mgon po la bskang bshags kyi cho ga dang*/ gdong bzhi pa la bskang gso rnams man ngag bzhin bya/ de ltar zhag gsum du thun bzhir bsgrubs pas rmi lam du khri la 'dug pa dang*/ rgyan gos bzang po bgo ba dang*/ lag na mtshon cha thogs pa dang*/ mi sha ma gtogs pa'i sha dang*/ kha zas sna tshogs ster ba byung na sngar bzhin gtor ma che ba gtang rag gi tshul du dbul/ gtor sgrub byed lugs gnyis po 'di la gtor ma rnams sgrub khang na rten gtor yod na de'i steng gi thad du spung bar bshad la/ rten gtor med na sa gtsang sar spungs te bzhag pa'am/ sngon gyi gtor ma rnying pa yod na/ der kha phyogs nas gtor ma rnams rdo la sogs pa'i steng du spungs la bzhag gi zor la sogs par mi bya'o// gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu dgra'am bgegs la sogs pas bar chad byung na dgra la rbad pa'i tshul gyis bsgrubs te/ de'ang gtor ma la kha na ma tho ba med pa'i sha dang*/ khrag gi mchod pa mang du bsham/ go mtshon dang stag gzig gi pags pa sogs spyan gzigs sna tshogs kyang bsham/ dngos gzhi bzlas pa'i skabs su/ rang yid dam du brtan par bsgoms pa'i thugs ka nas tsha zhing rtsub pa/

me stag lta bu'i 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi mgon po la phog pas mgon po'i thugs rgyud bskul/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas las kyi mgon po nag po gri thod can dpag tu med pa spros/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gang bar byas/ sgrub pa po la gnod pa'i dgra 'am bgegs gang yin pa de dngos su bzung ste/ tshe'i rgyun bcad/ bsod nams phrog stobs nyams par byas par bsam/ yang las kyi mgon po rnams kyis de'i yan lag bcings/ snying dral/ tho bas brdungs/ mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis lus dum bur byas par bsams la sngags ring thung rnams kyi mjug tu drag 'am bgegs che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces rkan sgra dang bcas pas drag tu bzlas/ nub gcig gi tshe gsang ba'i mchod gtor tshul bzhin du bya/ bstod pa rnams rgyas par bya zhing phrin las bcol pu tra rnams bskul ba'i tshig rgyas par bya zhing rgyun gtor gnod pa'i phyogs su kha bltas la btang*/ de'i tshe chos skyong 'khor bcas gtor ma phul bas mnyes te/ lus la go sna tshogs dang*/ phyag tu mtshon cha bzung nas dgra 'am bgegs kyi yul du dmag la phyin te/ de dag gi mkhar bshig lo tog nyams par byas/ stobs thams cad bcom par bsgoms la gtor ma rnams smad nas rim pa bzhin du zor du 'phangs la/ mthar mgon po'i gtor mas zor gzhug bsdu'o// de ltar zhag gsum du thun bzhir bsgrubs pas nyams sam rmi lam du/ mgo bo dang*/ glo snying ster ba'am ro ril po ster ba byung na gtor ma rnams zor du 'phangs pas las 'grub/ gal te mi nag po khab dang skud pa ster ba rmis na gtor ma zor du mi 'phang*/ sngar bzhin gtang rag tu btang bas las 'grub pa yin no// de la zor du 'phen na cho ga rnams zin pa dang*/ sgrub khang gi nang gi sa gzhi la ras la sogs pa'i steng du 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma go rim bzhin phab la bzhag phud kyis bran/ de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis dgra phyogs su kha bltas la dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyan sngar rang rang gi zhes sogs kyis mgon po bskul bas 'khor bcas khros shing 'khrugs te dgra'i yul du chas par bsgom/

'dis zor lam phye ba yin gsungs/ de nas phyi rol du rol mo dang bcas pas gtor ma bteg la/ ji ltar 'os pa'i sa gtsang sar phyin/ der yang gtor ma rnams phud kyis bran te/ khro tshul dang bcas pas/ mon bu pu tra nag po khyod// zhes sogs kyis pu tra las la drag tu bskul bas las kyis mgon po'i dmag dgra bo'i yul du chas par bsam/ yang dgra'i yul mthong ba'am mthun pa'i rlung rgyu bar phyin la der srung mas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gang bar bsgom/ de rnams la gtor ma las grub pa'i gla rngan gyi tshul du phul bar bsams la spyi bstab bya/ phud kyi mchod pa srung ma rnams kyis zos 'thung tshim par byas pas/ de dag gi mthu stobs rgyas par bsam/ de nas rdo rje zor 'dzin rnams kyis so so'i gtor ma bzung la srung ma rnams kyis gtor ma zos pa'i lhag ma rnams dug gi sdong bu dang*/ ral gri dang mdung thung la sogs pa'i mtshon cha me 'bar ba dang phur bu dang*/ dam shing dang*/ gri gug la sogs pa rnams su gyur pa las kyi mgon po la sogs pa rnams kyis bzung ste/ sgrub pa po dang lhan cig tu dgra bgegs rnams kyi stobs 'joms par bsam zhing*/ gnas de nyid las cung zad phyir nur te/ pho nya bskul ba'i tshig drag tu brjod/ de'i tshe gtor mgron gyi mgon po'i g.yas phyogs dang*/ steng gi ba spu'i bu ga nas bya nag dang*/ khyung chen gyi tshogs spros/ bstan pa la gnod pa'i gdug pa can dmigs yul de/ sa bla'i gnas nas bkug de bzhin du g.yon dang*/ rgyab nas khyi nag dang*/ ce spyang gi tshogs spros/ sa 'og nas gdug pa can bkug mdun nas mi nag 'jig rten gang bar spros/ sa stengs nas gdugs pa can bkug nas gtor ma gang du spungs pa'i sa der gnam lcags kyi dong gru gsum pa me 'bar bar bsam/ der pho nya rnams kyis gdug pa can de yan lag lcags sgrog dang zhags pas bsdams pa bzhag

de la bstan pa la gnod pa'i gdug pa can gzhan mtha' dag kyang bkug la bstim mo// de nas stobs sam srog gzhom pa man ngag bzhin du byas la/ gtor ma spungs pas srung ma rnams kyis gnod byed gnas de nyid du rdul phran tsam yang med par byas nas bcom par bsam/ gtor ma la bya khyi yun ring du bsrung*/ slar sngags ring shib bur bzlas shing*/ phyi mig mi lta bar nang du 'ongs la rjes kyi bya ba rnams bya'o// dus thams cad du snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa la nan tan du bya ba gces so// 'di bris dge ba phrin las kha dog can// dngos grub ba dan legs g.yo ru mtshon des// bdud dang mi mthun g.yul las rnam rgyal nas// thub dbang bstan pa'i khang bzang mdzes gyur cig /gtor ma la brten nas las sgrub pa'i man ngag g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba 'di ni/ sngar gyi gtor ma'i cho ga'i lhan thabs su dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi dgon par sbyar ba'o// // ༄// thugs dam bskang ba'i cho ga bzhugs so// ༈ /bla ma dang dpal rdo rje nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐ he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che// rnam 'phrul bye ba mtha' yas pas// dgra bgegs rdul bzhin brlag mdzad pa// mthu chen dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang*// hūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po khyod kyi sku// dus mtha'i sprin ltar cher gnag cing*// nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can// dpa' bo gar gyi nyams dgu ldan// de 'dra'i sku yi ting 'dzin mchog /rab tu gsal bar bsgom pa dang*// bsten cing rgyun du mchod pa yis// dpal mgon sku yi thugs dam bskang*// sna tshogs rin chen las grub pa'i// dbu rgyan mgul rgyan snyan cha dang*// dpung rgyan lag gdub do shal dang*// rkang gdub sor gdub rin chen rgyan// klu chen brgyad kyi sbrul rgyan dang*// rab mdzes dar gyi lhab lhub dang*// stag lpags sham thabs la sogs pas// ma hā kā la'i thugs dam bskang*// mi rus mchog las grub pa yi// 'khor lo rna cha mgul rgyan dang*// lag gdub dang ni ska rags sogs// rus rgyan drug gi rgyan cha dang*// thod skam lnga yi cod paṇa dang*// gdug pa can gyi mgo bo'i phreng*// khrag 'dzag lnga bcu'i do shal gyis// ma hā kā la'i thugs dam bskang*// rab mdzes rgyan gyi bye brag rnams// nag po chen po 'khor bcas kyi// sku la mchod pa phul ba yis// sku yi dam tshig nyams chags bskang*// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad dang gdon gyi gnod pa sogs// lus kyi bar chad zhi ba dang*// tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par mdzod// hūm̐ nag po chen po khyod kyi gsung*// bzhad sgra sngags kyi nga ro yis// 'brug stong 'khrugs pa zil gnon cing*// bdud dang log 'dren snying rab 'gems// de 'dra'i gsung gi rnal 'byor ni// rab tu gsal bar bsgom pa dang*// dran dang rgyun du bsten pa yis// dpal mgon gsung gi thugs dam bskang*// rtsa sngags snying po nye snying sogs// drag po'i gsang sngags zab mo rnams// dngos grub thams cad bsgrub pa'i phyir// dag cing gsal bar bzlas pa dang*// mgon po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi// bsnyen sgrub tshad du bskyal ba dang*// zab mo'i bzlas brjod rnam mang gis// ma hā kā la'i thugs dam bskang*// gzhan yang bstod dbyangs snyan pa yis// bstod tshig zab mo dpag med rnams// snyan cing brjid pas bstod pa dang*// bde gshegs gsung rab bsgrags pa dang*// rnga chen dung dang cha lang dang*// cang te'u 'khar rnga dril bu dang*// pi wang la sogs sgra snyan gyis// ma hā kā la'i thugs dam bskang*// sna tshogs rol mo'i bye brag rnams// nag po chen po 'khor bcas kyi// gsung la mchod pa phul ba yis// gsung gi dam tshig nyams chags bskang*// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// gzhan gyis ngag mnan byas pa sogs// ngag gi bar chad zhi ba dang*// snyan grags phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzod// hūm̐ nag po chen po khyod kyi thugs// zag med yon tan kun ldan zhing*// chos dbyings shin tu rnam dag la// spang bya'i dri ma kun dang bral// de 'dra'i thugs kyi yon tan ni// rab tu dad pas bsgoms pa dang*// bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin bsgrubs pa yis// dpal mgon thugs kyi=

/gri lcags chen po las grub pa'i// dam tshig rdo rje rtse lnga pa// rdo rje gri gug 'bar ba dang*// thod khrag rnam 'phrul gaṇ+ḍi dang*// sna tshogs rin chen las grub pa'i// 'khor lo rin chen pad+ma dang*// rdo rje rgya gram la sogs pas// ma hā kā la'i= /gser dngul bye ru mu tig dang*// mu men in+d+ra nī la sogs// yid 'og rin chen bsam yas dang*// dar chen kha dog sna tshogs dang*// ri mo sna tshogs rab bkra ba'i// zab chen kha dog du ma dang*// gos chen gser gyi rgyan ldan pas// ma hā kā la'i thugs dam bskang*// sna tshogs mchod pa'i yo byad rnams// nag po chen po 'khor bcas kyi// thugs la mchod pa phul ba yis// thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags bskang*// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// smyo 'bog sems 'khrugs la sogs pa// sems kyi bar chad zhi ba dang*// bsam don chos bzhin rgyas par mdzod// hūm̐ yon tan dpag yas mgon po khyod// stobs bcu mi 'jigs rnam bzhi dang*// ma 'dres dran pa nyer gzhag sogs// bsam yas yon tan kun dang ldan// de lta'i mgon po'i yon tan ni// dran cing dad pa bskyed pa dang*// dam chos tshul bzhin bzung ba yis// dpal mgon yon tan= /mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog dang*// bdug spos snang gsal dri mchog dang*// zhal zas sil snyan la sogs pa// nye bar spyod pa thams cad dang*// gzugs sgra la sogs 'dod yon lnga// dri lnga sman lnga 'bru sna lnga// snying po lnga sogs mchod rdzas kyis// ma hā kā la'i= /gzhan yang khyad 'phags rin chen bdun// lha mi'i yo byad bkra shis brgyad// gser gyi gdugs mdzes tog can dang*// yid bzhin du nor bu'i rgyal mtshan dang*// rnga yab dngul gyi yu ba can// 'phan dang ba dan lda ldi dang*// bla bre la sogs rgyan rnams kyis// ma hā kā la'i= /yid 'ong 'dod yon du ma rnams// nag po chen po=

/yon tan mchog la mchod pa yis// yon tan= /rnal 'byor= /gzhan gyi byad kha phur kha sogs// yon tan bar chad zhi ba dang*// sbyin sogs yon tan rgyas par mdzod// hūm̐ phrin las lhun grub nag po khyod// rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje las// gdug pa 'dul phyir khyod sprul nas// sangs rgyas bstan pa srung bar mdzad// da lta'i mgon po'i phrin las ni// dran dang las la bskul ba dang*// bde gshegs phrin las bskyangs pa yis// dpal mgon phrin las= /ral gri rtse gsum mdung thung dang*// spu gri gseg shang chu gri dang*// 'phang mdung thag mdung mdung rings dang*// wa mda' lcug mda' mda' bo che// gzhu dang phur bu dam shing dang*// dgra s+t+wa gtun shing lcags kyu dang*// dbyug pa s+t+wa re la sogs pas// ma hā kā la'i thugs dam bskang*// rta mchog nag po rdzu 'phrul shugs// seng chen 'gying 'dra rlung ltar mgyogs// gser sga dngul srab g.yu yi mthur// gser stan dar thag brgyan pa sogs// yid 'ong rta mchog mang po dang*// dre'u nag 'phar ba dgu chod dang*// srin po'i bong bu gwa dmar gyis// ma hā kā la'i thugs dam bskang*// g.yag rgod rog po mdangs ldan dang*// bdud lug nag po dpyid kar dang*// spu sdug mdzes pa'i bya nag dang*// khyi nag snying dkar la sogs pa// dud 'gro rnam pa sna tshogs dang*// seng ge stag gzig dom la sogs// gcan gzan rnam pa mang po yis// ma hā kā la'i thugs dam bskang*// khyung dang khu byug ne tso dang*// rma bya ngang pa ngur pa dang*// shang shang te'u la sogs pa// 'dab chags sna tshogs dkor nor ni// mchod 'os gzugs mdzes ci mchis pa// yan lag dbang po yongs rdzogs shing*// rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa 'dis// ma hā kā la'i thugs dam bskang*// ri mo rab bkra stag lpags dang*// thig le rab bkod gzig dang gung*// spu sdug grwa bzang dom dang dred// spu zhags mdog legs sram la sogs// gcan gzan pags pa sna tshogs dang*// khrab rmog ber chen phub la sogs// go cha sna tshogs rab btsan pas// ma hā kā la'i thugs dam bskang*// rdzas dang yo byad sna tshogs rnams// nag po chen po 'khor bcas kyi// phrin las mchog la mchod pa yis// phrin las dam tshig nyams chags bskang*// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// dgra dang chom rkun gnod pa sogs// phrin las bar chad zhi ba dang*// gzhan don chos bzhin rgyas par mdzod// hūm̐ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// thun mong ma yin mchod pa'i rdzas// bdud rtsir byin brlabs bdud rtsi lngas// ma hā kā la'i thugs dam bskang*// thabs kyi yo byad lcags kyu lnga// shes rab mchod pa 'bru bcud chang*// ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs pas// ma hā kā la'i thugs dam bskang*// mtshan ldan ye shes ka pā la// dam rdzas dzam+bu ti pa sogs// kha zas bzang dgus rab bkang bas// ma hā kā la'i thugs dam bskang*// bza' dang bca' ba yang dag ldan// kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa// rab mdzes rgyan gyis rnam brgyan nas// sngags dang phyag rgyas rgya cher spel// ro brgya ldan pa'i gtor ma 'dis// ma hā kā la'i thugs dam bskang*// dpal ldan mgon po thugs dam bskang*// bstan srung chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// hūm̐ sprul pa'i khyung chen bya nag tshogs// ce spyang mi nag khyi nag dang*// khro chung pho nya yang sprul rnams// mchod spyin gtor mas thugs dam bskang*// yum chen e ka dza ṭī dang*// lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma// ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor mas thugs dam bskang*// dam can gnod sbyin yab yum dang*// bka' sdod pu tra ming sring dang*// ru 'dren sde bzhi 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor mas thugs dam bskang*// dur khrod bdag po phyogs skyong dang*// zhing skyong lha srin sde brgyad dang*// dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud kun// mchod sbyin gtor mas thugs dam bskang*// gtor ma gsol zhing btung ba dang*// bzhes shing bsnams par mdzad nas kyang*// 'gro la zhi rgyas srung skyob rnams// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin mdzod// dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i thugs dam bskang ba'i cho ga
dam pa gcung gis mdzad pa las/ tshig don gyi cha mi bde ba rnams shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi dgon par bcos zhing dag par bgyis so// //

༄// dpal kye rdo rje lha bcu bdun ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal kye rdo rje lha bcu bdun gyi bdag nyid can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs gsang don gsal byed ces bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// ri bong 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor zung ldan dang*// rab dkar rdo rje rtse lnga las byung ba'i// mtha' yas bdud kyi tshogs 'joms he ru ka /dpal ldan kye yi rdo rje la phyag 'tshal// rgyud dang rje btsun rtse mo'i rnam bshad dang*// 'phags yul mkhas pa'i gzhung gi rjes 'brangs nas// bcu bdun bdag nyid kye yi rdo rje yi// sgrub thabs gsang don gsal byed bdag gis bri// 'dir dpal sam+bu ṭa'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs nas rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bya ba la/ lha'i rnal 'byor sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor/ rjes thun mtshams kyi bya ba dang gsum gyi dang po la/ tshogs gnyis bsag pa/ srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ dbang thob pa ma nyams pa'i rnal 'byor pas dur khrod la sogs pa'i dben gnas su bde ba'i stan la rdo rje skyil krung gis 'dug nas/ rang skad cig gis dpal kye rdo rjer gsal ba'i snying gar paṃ las pad+ma dmar po dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ sngon po gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba/ de las dbugs phyir rgyu ba'i dus su sna bug g.yas nas 'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i tshul can 'phros pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mngon sum du bzhugs par bltas la rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar te/ gang phyir thabs chen bdag nyid ni// dngos rnams kun gyi rang bzhin can// dpal ldan kun rtog thams cad spangs// mgon po he ru ka la 'dud// 'khor ba 'jig pa'i me byung nad dang mya ngan bye ba'i 'od 'phro bar// ltung ba chu bur nad gyur bzlog dka' 'gro ba nyam thag zhi bya'i phyir// snying rje'i bdud rtsi'i char gyis chus gang byams pa'i chu bo ni// gang 'di kun tu rab 'bab sangs rgyas bcom ldan de la 'dud// ces pas phyag byas nas/

rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i me tog ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams la/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags rgyas me tog nas zhal zas kyi bar gyis mchod la/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las gau rī la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad rang rang gi mchod rdzas 'dzin pa spros te/ de rnams kyis mchod par bsams la/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung*// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa yis// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod// ces pas mchod nas/ bdag gis thog ma med dus nas// log rtog dbang gis sdig bgyis gang*// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag khyed rnams kyi// spyan sngar bshags bgyid slan chad sdom// rgyal dang de yi sras rnams dang*// rang sangs rgyas dang dgra bcom dang*// 'gro ba'i bsod nams ma lus pa// de la yang dag yi rang zhing*// byang chub dam par bsngo bar bgyi// gang dang gang gis 'dul 'gyur ba// de dang de yi skur ston pa'i// sna tshogs gzugs nor ji lta bu'i// rdzogs sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi// kun rtog ma lus dag gyur pa// rang gi yang dag ye shes bskyed// lhan cig skyes dga'i ngo bo nyid// dam pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi// go rim ji bzhin dbang bskur thob// ma log lam la nges gnas pa'i// sras mchog 'khor 'dus tshogs mchog la// rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi// yang dag ye shes me bo ches// gti mug mun pa bsal ba dang*// sgrib pa ma lus sbyang ba'i phyir// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do// rgyal sras dpa' bo rnams kyi lam// spyod pa dpag g.yas gang yin dang*// ma bcos ji bzhin gnas lam la// da ni yang dag gnas par bgyi// zhes lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags byas te/

de nas nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig dgra gnyen chags sdang thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig ces pa'i tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms te/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas phyi nang gi chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur bsams la/ dngos po bden brdzun rnam dpyad na// rtogs pas byas kyang bsgom mi nus// skye ba med pa sbyor ba yis// skye ba 'dir ni rab bshad do// oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs te sngon 'gro tshogs gnyis bsags pa'o// gnyis pa srung ba'i 'khor lo la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo gnyis kyi dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo nyi shu pa/ shar dkar/ lhor ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs su 'phros pas rdo rje nag po gdengs pa 'greng bur gyur pa bar mtshams med pa'i rwa ba/ steng du 'phros pas rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ 'og tu 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ phyir 'phros pas ye shes kyi me kha dog lnga 'bar bas bskor ba bsams la/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas brtan par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i thun mong gi srung 'khor gyi dbus su/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ ser po las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ rtse mo rno ba/ khog pa stong pa/ g.yas phyogs su 'gro ba mi mngon par mgyogs par 'khor ba/ de'i dbus dang phyogs bcur pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bcu gcig de rnams kyi steng du hūm̐ re re/ de'ang lho'i dkar po/

nub kyi dmar po/ steng gi ser po/ gzhan rnams sngon po/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad sku mdog sngon po phyag g.yas pas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ shar du gshin rje'i gshed sngon po tho ba 'dzin pa/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma/ byang du bgegs mthar byed nag po rdo rje/ dbang ldan du 'dod rgyal nag po lcags kyu/ mer dbyug sngon can nag po dbyug pa/ bden bral du stobs po che nag po rtse gsum/ rlung du mi g.yo ba nag po ral gri/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po 'khor lo/ 'og tu gnod mdzes nag po gtun shing 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang g.yas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dbus dang phyogs bzhi'i khro bo rnams zhal mche ba gtsigs shing*/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ sku sbom shing thung la gsus khyim che ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ mtshams kyi khro bo rnams ni rol pa'i sku can/ cung zad sgeg cing yid tsam khros pa/ sku skem zhing grims pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ thams cad kyi sku las rang dang 'dra ba'i khro bo dpag tu med pa 'phro bas bgegs kyi tshogs tshar gcod par mdzad pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsams te dam tshig pa bskyed pa'o// de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas khro bo bcu gcig srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa la ye shes kyi khro bo bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba spyan drangs la mchod nas/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar sgo ma bzhi'i sngags rgyas dgug gzhug bcing dbang du byas te ye shes pa gzhug pa'o// lha thams cad kyi mig la sogs pa'i gnas drug tu/

gti mug rdo rje ma la sogs pa drug dang*/ gnas gsum du yi ge gsum dgod de skye mched dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa'o// slar yang snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la/ chu bzhi sngon du 'gro bas mchod cing*/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lhas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad dang sngags kyis dbang bskur/ lus gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las hūm̐ mdzad/ shes rab mthar byed 'dod pa'i rgyal po gnod mdzes rnams la mi bskyod pa/ gshin rje'i gshed dbyug sngon can gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/ pad+ma mthar byed dang stobs po che la 'od dpag med/ bgegs mthar byed dang*/ mi g.yo ba la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan pa ni dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab bo// de nas khro bo'i dbang po rnams kyi sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas bdud dang log par 'dren pa rnams dpag tshad brgya'i pha rol du bskrad cing bar du gcod pa rnams las bsrung bar bsams te/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sogs brjod pa ni srung ba'i 'khor lo'o// gnyis pa rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor dngos la/ bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis kyi dang po la/ rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa dang*/ brten pa lha bskyed pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ srung 'khor gyi rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad zhu ba las/ chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ de'i nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas bskor ba/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/

de rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa'i steng du/ bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ de rnams la oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho/ dmar po gnyis kyi mtha' brten pa'i bar do'i shes pa zhugs nas/ thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du/ rin po che'i pha gu ser po la/ drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ steng mda' yab dang pu shus mdzes par byas pa/ sgo bzhi'i thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor/ chos kyi 'khor lo/ steng du gdugs/ g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo/ gos la sogs pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ rtsig pa'i rtsa ba'i phyi rol na 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la/ pi waṃ ma la sogs pa mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis rang rang gi mchod rdzas thogs nas dkyil 'khor la mchod pa 'bul ba/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing*/ steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ dwangs shing sgrib pa med pa'i 'od zer kun du 'khrugs pa/ de'i nang du sgo nas phyogs kyi mdog can gyi lha snam cha chen re bor ba'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i phyi rol rdo rje phreng ba dang 'od zer lnga'i phreng bas bskor ba/ pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du nyon mongs pa la sogs pa bdud bzhi'i ngo bo tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang sngon po/ drag po nag po rnams gong nas gong du brtsegs pa'i gdan/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du tshangs pa ser po/ lhor dbang po dkar po/ nub tu nye dbang sngon po/ byang du drag po nag po/ byang shar du gshin rje sngon po/ shar lhor nor bdag ser po/

lho nub tu srin po nag po/ nub byang du thag zangs ris dud kha rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa/ sgo bzhir sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ ro'i gdan/ mtshams bzhir pad+ma dang*/ nyi ma'i gdan bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nī la ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas nga rgyal bzung ngo*// gnyis pa la dang po sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ de nas dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du ā li phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa ā lis mtshan pa me long lta bu'i ye shes su mos te/ de las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas kyi mtshan so gnyis ā li'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ sngar gyi yi ge la thim pas rgyas par bsgom/ de'i steng du kā li sum cu rtsa bzhi ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha drug bsnan pas bzhi bcu pa phrag gnyis yongs su gyur pa las zla ba gru gsum kā lis mtshan pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes su mos te/ de las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad brgyad cu kā li'i rnam par spyan drangs pa sngar gyi yi ge la thim pas rgyas par bsgom/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po 'od zer gyi phreng ba can bsgoms te so sor rtog pa'i ye shes su mos la/ de las 'od 'phros/ des sems can thams cad kyi don byas slar 'dus te zla ba rdo rje la thim pas/ thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur pa bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes su mos/ de yongs su gyur pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ bcom ldan kun tu bzang po sku mdog zla ba ltar dkar zhing chu shel ltar dwangs pa/ nor bu ltar 'od 'phro ba/ zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhis mdzes pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po g.yas sngo g.yon dmar ba/ lhag ma thams cad nag po dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes shing spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/

phyag bcu drug gis dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na ral gri/ gsum pa na mda'/ bzhi pa na 'khor lo/ lnga pa na gshor te chang gis gang ba'i thod pa/ drug pa na dbyug pa/ bdun pa na rtse gsum/ brgyad pa na lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na pad+ma/ gsum pa na gzhu/ bzhi pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'phyar bzhin pa/ lnga pa na thod pa/ drug pa na rin po che/ bdun pa na sdigs mdzub/ brgyad pa na rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can 'khor lo la sogs pa rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs bzhi'i zhabs g.yon gnyis brkyang pa'i brla la g.yas gnyis gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs shing sgeg pa la sogs pa gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ dku g.yon du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin cing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas pas yab la 'khril ba/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsams te/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed pa'o// yab yum snyoms par bzhugs pa'i sgras nam mkha' nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho gnyis kyi mtha' brten pa'i bar do'i shes pa bcom ldan 'das kyi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ yum gyi mkhar sleb pa'i rkyen gyis yab yum gnyis rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu ste/ bde ba chen po'i ngo bo thig le sngo skyar gyur par bsams la/ de nas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas puk+ka sī la sogs pa'i lha mo bzhi byung ste/ pad+ma'i mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la 'khod nas/ bde stong dbyer med chos sku'i ngo bo bcom ldan 'das gzugs skur bzhengs pa'i phyir glus bskul ba ni/

rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig /puk+ka si' ni bdag la skyobs// stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spangs la// bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed mdzod// khyod med na ni bdag 'gum pas// kye yi rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spangs la// ri khrod ma 'bras grub par mdzod// dga' gtso 'jig rten mgron gnyer ba// stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci// khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas// gdol pa mo bdag zhu bar bgyid// bdag gis khyod kyi thugs 'tshal gyis// mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig /g.yung mo bdag ni dran nyams pas// snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig /ces pas bskul ba ni zhu ba glus bskul te/ de ltar glus bskul ba'i rkyen dang*/ sngon gyi smon lam rjes su dran pa'i thig le de am̐ dang hūm̐ du gyur pa las sam/ yang na/ thig le de hūm̐ dang a las rdo rje dang gri gug hūm̐ dang am̐ gis mtshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bcom ldan 'das kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon po/ rtsa zhal sngo zhing bzhad pa/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba lhag ma thams cad rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bu yum dang bcas pa bsams te/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las pad+ma as mtshan par bsams la/ oṃ pad+ma su kha dha ra ma hā rā ga su khaṃ da da tsa tur ā nan+da bha ga bi shā hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kār+yaṃ kā ru ṣ+wa me/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā dwe/ tsa tur ā nan+da ya ka kha ga mu kha e ka ra so na tha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kār+ya ku ru ṣ+wa me/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing thabs shes snyoms par zhugs pas/ bde ba'i sgras sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/

thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes bzhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud de yum kyi bha gar babs nas/ gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐/ bam̐ biṃ mum̐ mriṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pa'i sa bon bcu drug tu gyur/ de las lha mo bcu drug tu gyur nas phyir spros pas/ shar du gau rī dkar mo phyag dang po gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs shing*/ 'og ma gnyis gri gug dang*/ nya ro hi ta dang bcas pa'i thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ lhor tsau rī ma dmar mo phyag dang po gnyis kyi 'khor lo dang lcags kyu/ 'og ma gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang*/ phag pa dang bcas pa'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu be tā lī dkar ser dang po gnyis kyis ral gri dang rus sbal dang bcas pa'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis chang gis bkang ba'i thod pa dang dri chus bkang ba'i thod pa/ byang du ghasma rī ljang ser dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje'i me thab dang dgra s+t+wa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ sbrul dang bcas pa'i tshigs bus gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du puk+ka sī ser mo dang po gnyis kyis dpag bsam gyi shing gi lcugs ma dang seng ge dang bcas shing shas gang ba'i thod pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ shar lhor ri khrod ma dkar mo dang po gnyis kyis kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang dge slong dang bcas pa'i thod pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gdol pa ma sngon mo dang po gnyis kyis rlung gi gos 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis pad dkar dang stag dang bcas pa'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du g.yung mo sngo ba dang dkar ba'i mdog can dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang lcags kyu/ 'og ma gnyis kyi rlung ras dang wa dang bcas pa'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/

skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// 'dir rgyud phyi ma las shar du dkar mo/ g.yas su chom rkun ma/ rgyab tu rab tu rmongs ma/ g.yon du ro langs ma/ mer puk+ka sī/ bden bral du gdol pa mo/ rlung du ghasma rī/ dbang ldan du he ru ka dang mtshungs pa rnams bshad cing*/ brtag pa gsum pa'i rab byed dang por yang 'di dang go rim mtshungs par bshad pa ni/ skabs 'di dag sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ brtag pa gnyis pa gnyis kyi gsal byed kyi gzhung yin pa la/ 'dir brtag pa gnyis kyi gsal byed du sbyor bas na/ go rim 'di ltar 'byung bar rigs te/ glu bskul gyi skabs su mtshams ma bzhi rtsa rgyud ltar bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ a bha yas kyang 'di bzhin du bshad pa'i phyir ro// lha snam mtshams bzhi'i gdan la/ dbang ldan du gling bu ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyi gling bu 'bud pa/ mer pi wang ma ser mo phyag gnyis kyis pi wang bsgreng ba/ bden bral du mu kun+da dmar mo phyag gnyis kyi rnga zlum brdung ba/ rlung du rdza rnga ma ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis rdza rnga kha gcig pa brdung ba/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ skra grol ba phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs can/ sgeg cing mdzes pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'o// shar sgor rta gdong ma nag mo dbus gnag g.yas dkar g.yon ser/ steng zhal rta'i gdong pa ljang gu g.yas gnyis na lcags kyu ral gri g.yon gnyis na zhags pa dang sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa/ lhor sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ g.yas nag g.yon dkar/ steng du phag gdong ma dmar mo/ phyag g.yas gnyis na zhags pa dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis na 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo dbus dmar/ g.yas nag g.yon dkar/ steng du khyi gdong ser mo/

phyag g.yas gnyis na lcags sgrog dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis na 'khor lo dang dril bu/ byang sgor seng gdong ma ljang gu dbus ljang*/ g.yas nag g.yon dkar/ steng du seng gdong dkar mo/ phyag g.yas gnyis na dril bu dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis na 'khor lo dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ lhag zhal rnams la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa phyag rgya lnga dang sbrul gyis brgyan cing*/ thod pa'i phreng ba'i cod paṇa can khro zhing sgeg pa'i ro'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// gsum pa ni/ de nas lha thams cad kyi thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ la sogs pa rang rang gi sa bon las so so'i phyag mtshan so so'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa dang rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ la sogs pa'i so so'i sa bon bsgoms te/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsgom pa'o// ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa spyan drangs/ nyer spyod dang lha mo brgyad kyis mchod de/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyis thugs kyi mchog brnyes te// khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te// snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa// sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje sgrub pa yid// he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dgyes// zhes pas bstod la/ snying ga'i sa bon las rta gdong ma lcags kyu thogs pa spros te ye shes pa'i thugs kar reg pas srung 'khor gyi nang du byon par bsams la/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ba ḍa bā mu kha yo gī shwa ri hī hi hi hi hi hūm̐ dzaḥ

zhes brjod/ yang phag gdong ma zhags pa thogs pa spros/ ye shes pa'i mgrin par reg pas dam tshig pa la thim par bsam zhing*/ zhags pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra daṃṣ+ṭaṃ ba rā ha mu khi trāṃ ba trā ṭa hūm̐ zhes brjod/ yang seng gdong ma lcags sgrog thogs pa spros/ ye shes pa'i zhabs la reg pas dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par bsams la/ lcags sgrog gi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra pra sūr+ya hu tā sha ni siṃ ha nirnā de siṃ ha bak+t+re siṃ hi ni ṭaṃ ṭaṃ maṃ zhes brjod/ yang khyi gdong ma dril bu thogs pa spros/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi nang thams cad gang bas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dgyes par bsam/ dril bu'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dhā tu saṃ dzī ba ni ma hā yak+ṣi ṇi shwā na rū pi ṇi ma hā prā la ya nir+ṇa de kā ma rā pi ṇi trām̐ tra ṭa tra ṭa hoḥ /zhes brjod de ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dgug gzhug bya'o// de nas lha thams cad kyi mig gnyis su maṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna ba gnyis su daṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon mo/ snar paṃ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ lcer raṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral par aṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang gu/ snying gar naṃ las bdag med rdo rje ma nag mo/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ snying gar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ma nag mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa dang gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ ro'i gdan la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs par bsam pa ni/ skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa'o// slar yang snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ dbang bskur gyi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yum bzhi/ sems dpa' brgyad/ khro bo bcu/ lha mo bcu dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/

sngar bzhin mchod bstod byas nas/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyis// khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams he ru ka'i gzugs su gyur te/ bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa phyag na bsnams nas dbang bskur bar bsams la/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas/ lus thams cad gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa la gtso bo yab yum dang*/ gau rī dang puk+ka sī la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang sha ba rī la rnam par snang mdzad/ bai tā li dang tsaṇ+ḍa lī la rin 'byung*/ ghasma rī dang ḍom+bī nī la 'od dpag med/ phyi'i lha rnams kyi shar dang byang shar ba la rnam snang*/ lho dang shar lho ba la rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub dang lho nub ba la 'od dpag med/ byang dang nub byang pa la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan par bsams la dbang gi lha thams cad mi dmigs par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ// zhes brjod pa ni dbang bskur zhing rgyas gdab pa'o// de nas mdun du thod par chang la bdud rtsi ril bu sbags pas bkang ba bzhag nas/ de bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs pa rnams gtor ma byin rlabs dang mthun par byas la/ lha bcu bdun gyi ljags rnams la rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyis mtshan par bsams nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badz+ra swa da na badz+rī swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pa ni bdud rtsi myang ba'o// sngar ltar lha mo brgyad kyis mchod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ mchod pa'i lha mo de rnams kyis dkyil 'khor pa la bstod par bsams la/

'gro ba dug chen mi bzad pas// khyab par bzhugs nas he ru ka /sna tshogs tshul gyi bdud rtsir bsgyur// sman mchog dpa' bo khyod la 'dud// ces dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ// zhes brjod de mchod do// 'dir dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la gzhung 'khrugs med du byas te ting nge 'dzin gsum dang sbyar ba dang*/ 'khrugs can du sbyar te yan lag drug tu sbyar ba gnyis gdam ga can du 'grel par bshad cing*/ gzhung gi dngos bstan dang 'khrugs med ting nge 'dzin gsum dang sbyar ba shin tu mthun pas 'dir de'i lugs su bkod do// gal te spyi don du he ru ka so so dang bdag med ma rnams la ting nge 'dzin gsum mi sbyor bar bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na mi 'gal te/ de ltar bshad pa ni slob dpon mi thub zla ba'i dgongs pa ltar na yin gyi/ gzhan du 'grel par ting nge 'dzin gsum sbyor bar rje btsun nyid kyis bshad pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rang byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi nas gang yang rung ba cig bsgoms te/ slob dpon gyi ngag las shes so// gsum pa thun mtshams kyis bya ba la/ nyal ba la sogs pa lnga ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs su bstan pa ltar shes par byas la/ thun mtshams su bsgoms pas skyo na/ dkyil 'khor bsdus la rang gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis/ snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po la// byams pa'i thugs ni yan lag gnag /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yis ni// zhabs ni rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod// zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad// phyag ni stong pa bcu drug yin// gug skyed kyis ni sangs rgyas lnga// gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo nyid// spyan gsum pa ni sku gsum yin// rus pa bden pa bzhi po nyid// gzugs ni sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad// tshor ba rdo rje nyi ma ste// 'du shes pad+ma gar dbang phyug

/de bzhin 'du byed rdo rje rgyal// rnam shes rdo rje sems dpa' nyid// kun gyi ngo bo he ru ka /mig la gti mug rdo rjer bshad// zhe sdang rdo rje mngon thos pa// phrag dog rdo rje de bzhin sna// kha ni 'dod chags rdo rjer bshad// reg la ser sna rdo rje ma// khams dang skye mched thams cad ni// dam pa'i dbang phyug he ru ka /sa yi khams ni ltung byed ma// chu khams gsod par byed mar brjod// me yi khams ni 'gugs byed ma// de bzhin rlung ni gar dbang phyug /nam mkha'i khams su brjod pa ni// pad+ma 'bar ba 'khyil ba nyid// 'di ltar lus can rnams kyi lus// phung po la sogs lha'i bdag nyid// bde dang sdug bsngal de bzhin las// nyon mongs la sogs nges skyes pa// bskyed pa'i cha la legs gnas nas// srid dang mya ngan 'das pa thob// zhes dag pa dran par byas nas/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i bgrang phreng bzung ste/ rang gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i/ yum gyi thugs ka'i am̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba zhi sogs kyi las dang mthun pa'i kha dog can spros pas yum gyi zhal nas 'thon/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas byung ste/ pad+mar zhugs nas sku'i dbyibs brgyud de/ yang yum gyi zhal nas byung bar bsgom zhing*/ 'khor rnams kyi steng 'og tu 'khor bar bsams la/ oṃ aṣ+ṭā na nā ya/ piṃ ga lor+dhā ke sha warta ma ne/ tsa turbiṃ sha ti ne trā ya/ ṣo ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/ kṛ ḍa bhu dzā ya/ wa pu ṣe/ kā pā la mā lā ne ka dhā ri ṇi/ ādh+ma ta krū ra tsit+tā ya/ ar+dhen+du daṃ ṣ+ṭā+-i ṇe/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sap+ta sā ga rā na/ ban+dha ban+dha/ nā ga aṣ+ṭa kān/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ sha trūn/ ha hā/ hi hī/ hu hū/ he hai/ ho hau/ haṃ haḥphaṭa swā hā/ rtsa sngags so// rgyud 'dir rtsa sngags ma bshad pas bzla dgos pa'i nges pa mi snang yang*/

dkyil 'khor 'di'i pi wang ma la sogs pa bzhi spangs pa lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon kaṃ pa las mdzad par rtsa rgyud bzhin rtsa sngags bzlas bar bshad la/ sngags don dang lha'i rnam pa mthun pas 'dir yang bris so// oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'o// oṃ hriḥswā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'o// oṃ aṃ swā hā/ bdag med ma'i'o// oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya sid+dhi sa ra ma yo ge shwa ri kā pa la ma la dha ri ṇi ru dhi ra pri yesh+ma sha na pā si nī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ dkar mo'o// oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍe shwa ri kha ṭ+wāṃ ṅgi ma hā badz+ri nī ka pā la mā la mu ku ṭo ā ka ḍha/ sarba duṣ+ṭa da pa mā kaṭ+ṭa ru lu ru lu bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ chom rkun mo'o// oṃ badz+ra be tā li/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba duṣ+ṭa bi kṛ te be ṣa dha ri ṇi bi kṛ tā a laṃ ka ra bhu ṣe te/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ mā bi laṃ ba mā bi laṃ ba sa ma ya ma nu sma ra pra be sha ya maṇ+ḍa la ma d+ye ut+thā pa ya sarba hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ro langs ma'i'o// oṃ badz+ra ma he shrī ri haṃ haṃ haṃ haṃ ha ru lu ru lu bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ ghasma rī'i'o// oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wa ti badz+ra gu h+ye shwa ri ba hu bi dha ba sha dha ri ṇi/ sarba ta thā ga ta duṣ+ṭe sa ma ya nu sma ra ha na ha na raṅga raṅga raṅga pā ya raṅga pā ya/ pū ra ya pū ra ya/ ā bi sha ya ā bi sha ya sarba bhū ta narta narta/ nartā pa ya nartā pa ya/ haḥha ha ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ hām̐ phaṭa swā hā/ puk+ka sī'i'o// ri khrod ma'i sngags rgyud 'dir gsal bar ma bshad pas rtsa rgyud ltar/ oṃ shaṃ badz+ra sha ba ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'am/ yang na/ oṃ badz+ra a pa ri dzi te pa ra ma gu h+ye ka pā la ma la bi bhū ṣi te sarba duṣ+ṭa mo ha ni pri ye/ e h+ye hi bha ga wa ti/ badz+ra gu h+ye shwa ri ba hu bi bi dha be sha dha ra ṇi/ sarba duṣ+ṭa ni ba ra ṇa hūm̐ swā hā/

rab tu rmongs ma'i'o// zhes pa 'di bzlas kyang chog par mngon te/ ba hu bi bi dha bi sha dha ri ṇi ces pa ni mang po sna tshogs kyi cha byad 'dzin ma zhes pa yin la/ 'di'i don mnyam sbyor du rab tu rmongs ma'i cha byad dang*/ rgyud 'dir ri khrod ma'i cha byad sogs mang po 'dzin pas zhes pa yin pas/ slar 'di rab rmongs ma dang ri khrod ma gnyis ka'i thun mong ba yin nam snyam ste dpyad par bya'o// oṃ badz+ra shū la a graṃ bhin+da bhin+da sarba duṣ+ṭa hṛ da yaṃ ma ā kar+ṣa pa ā kar+ṣa ya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ nirma nirma tha/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ mā bi laṃ ba mā bi laṃ ba sa ma ya ma nu sma ra hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gdol pa mo'i'o// oṃ suṃ bha ni dīp+ta sa ma ya badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa he ru ka dang mtshungs pa'i g.yung mo'i'o// oṃ badz+ra baṃ she hūm̐ swā hā/ gling bu ma'i'o// oṃ badz+ra bī ṇi hūm̐ swā hā/ pi waṃ ma'i'o// oṃ badz+ra mu kun+te hūm̐ swā hā/ mu kun+te'i'o// oṃ mṛ daṅga hūm̐ swā hā/ rdza rnga ma'i'o// sgo ma bzhi'i sngags sngar bstan pa'i sngags la swā hā btags la bzlas te 'di gtso bo la ji tsam bzlas pa'i bcu cha 'khor rnams la bzla ba ni bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro// de ltar bsgom bzlas kyi skyo na thun mtshams su tshogs bsags pa'i don du sa phyogs yid du 'ong bar ba yi rnam lngas legs par byugs/ der tsan+dan dkar pos chos 'byung gru gsum pa ji ltar rigs par byas pa'i dbus su khru gang gi tshad tsam gyis tsan+dan dmar po dang gur gum la sogs pa'i dri dmar pos dkyil 'khor gru bzhi bya/ de la zlum por bskor te thig gcig btab nas/ le tshe dgur byas pa'i dbus ma la lha bcu bdun gyi me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ de'i phyi rol gyi le tshe brgyad la zhing skyong brgyad chung ma dang bcas pa'i me tog gi tshom bu le tshe re re la lnga lnga bya/ de dag gi mdun rang gi g.yon nas brtsams te/

chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ g.yas su 'das pa'i gtor ma dang*/ g.yon du 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma bsham/ rang gi g.yon du thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dang*/ rdo rje dril bu rnams bzhag la/ le tshe dbus ma'i dkyil 'khor bsang sbyangs pa'i ngang las srung ba'i 'khor lo gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis bskyed la/ gtso bo'i gnas su dri'i thig le gru bzhi dang*/ 'khor rnams la zlum por byas nas/ dbus su hūm̐ shrī he ru ka ya na maḥ dpal kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa sogs dang*/ shar du gaṃ badz+ra gau rī na maḥ gau rī dkar mo sogs brgyad dang*/ phyi'i lha snam gyi dbang ldan du/ baṃ badz+ra baṃ s+ya na maḥ mer biṃ badz+ra bi ṇe/ bden bral du muṃ badz+ra mu kun+te/ rlung du mṛṃ badz+ra mṛ daṃ ge shar sgor dzaḥbadz+ra ba ḍa ba mu khī na maḥ lho sgor hūm̐ badz+ra ba ra hā mu khī/ nub sgor baṃ badz+ra shwa na mu khī/ byang sgor hoḥbadz+ra siṃ ha mu khī na ma/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i rang rang gi mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro bas/ dri'i thig le dang me tog gi tshom bu byas la/ lha yongs su rdzogs par bsgoms te dam tshig pa bskyed pa'o// de nas lag pa gnyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ ku ru ku ru sa ma ya a dhi pa ti hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ zhes pas ye shes pa spyan drangs la mchod pa nas rta gdong ma la sogs pa'i sngags rgyas dgug gzhug bcing*/ dbang du byas te ye shes pa gzhug pa'o// de nas mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma la sogs pa drug bsgoms te/ skye mched byin gyis brlab pa'o// yang dbang bskur gyi lha spyan drangs nas mchod cing gsol ba btab ste/ dbang bskur nas sngar ltar rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa ni/ dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa'o// de ltar mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor yan lag bzhi rdzogs par bsgrub pa la phyi nang gi mchod pa dbul ba'i phyir/
