las thams cad pa'i dri chu'am/ chang la bdud rtsi'i ril bu sbyar bas/ mchod rdzas rnams la gtor zhing*/ a mṛ ta brjod pas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod par hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod rdzas su bsams la/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i so so'i sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra/ zhes pa thog mar sbyar la/ nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur las gung mo gnyis rtse sprad pa zhabs bsil gyi phyag rgya dang*/ de bzhin sngar gyi sngags kyi rjes la/ ne wi ti hūm̐ khaṃ gis zhal bsil dang*/ sarba saṃ sho dha ni hūm̐ gis 'thor 'thung dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ mchod yon te chu bzhi ka'ang phyag rgya ni 'dra'o// de nas me tog gi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog bdug pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dhū be āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos dang*/ mar me'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ dri'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri mchog zhal zas kyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi te āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas dang*/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gis sam/ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta'i sngags kyis rol mo dbul te/ phyi'i mchod pa'o// de nas sngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod kyi dbus nas mtheb srin gyis blangs nas gtor zhing*/ thog mar rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la dbul/ de nas 'di'i brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*/ yi dam gyi lha rnams kyi sngags la oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la dbul/ de nas mchod skyong dang*/ phyogs skyong dang*/ gzhi bdag rnams la'ang dbul nas rang nyid kyis kyang myangs te/ de nang gi mchod pa'o// de nas mchod pa nyi shu pa dang*/ lha mo brgyad la sogs pas mchod cing*/ 'di rnams rgyas par spro na bdag gis bla mas mdzad pa'i rdo rje gur gyi mchod phreng ltar shes par bya ste/

yid las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod pa'o// de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas de wa da ru'i glu'i bstod pa'am/ yang na/ stong pa'i snying por phyag 'tshal bstod// rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes tshogs// ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro ba'i mi shes gcod pa can// dag pa'i de nyid ston mdzad pa// bdag med chos las byung ba yi// rdo rje sems dpar phyag 'tshal bstod// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems// pha rol phyin pa'i yon tan kun// mgon po las ni rtag tu byung*// byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal bstod// dkon mchog gsum dang theg chen dang*// de bzhin brtan dang 'gro ba dang*// khams gsum po ni 'di dag kun// 'gro ba'i dpa' bor phyag 'tshal bstod// yid bzhin nor ltar gyur pa yi// 'gro ba'i 'dod pa'i don bsgrub phyir// dpa' ldan bde gshegs bka' bzhin mdzad// sangs rgyas sras por phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod pa'i mchod pa'o// de nas gtor ma gnyis ka bdud rtsi dang chu dang chang gis sbyangs la/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung dang*/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a las thod pa dum bu gsum pa/ dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ shar du go las ba lang gi sha/ lhor ku las khyi'i sha/ nub tu da las rta'i sha/ byang du a las glang po che'i sha/ dbus su na las mi'i sha/ sha lnga po re re'i steng du/ bh+rūm̐ las dri chen/ aṃ las rak+ta/ dz+rīṃ las byang sems/ khaṃ las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ hūm̐ las dri chu ste bdud rtsi lnga lnga dang*/ de rnams kyi steng du bh+rūm̐ la sogs pa'i sa bon lnga bsams la/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor du/ ā li bcu drug g.yon skor dang*/ kā li so bzhi g.yas skor du bsams te/ de dag gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo thur du blta ba'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/

de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos shing me sbar nas thod pa'i nang gi sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga po zhu zhing bskol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song bas oṃ dang hūm̐ la phog de gnyis las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par spyan drangs/ rdo rje'i hūm̐ la thim pas rdo rje ljid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung bas rdzas rnams thams cad zhu nas kha dog dang dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par bsams nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ yang yang brjod pas/ gtor ma gnyis ka dus gcig la byin gyis brlab bo// de nas 'das gtor dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma'i phud rnams dbul ba'i phyir/ mdun gyi re mig dbus ma'i lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po nas 'bras tsam gyis mtshan pa de las 'od byung bas gtor ma drangs shing gsol bar bsams la/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye nas/ oṃ bha ga wāṃ ma hā ka ru ṇi ka hṛ da ya he badz+ra/ naṃ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ/ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ baṃ biṃ muṃ mṛṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ/ bhuñdza/ dziṃ gha/ phul+la/ dhū pa/ māṃ sa/ piṃ ga am+ba/ sap+pa/ kadz+dza/ sā dā/ khaṇ+ṭi/ khu ṇi/ phai ḍa gā da/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ/ zhes sogs lan gsum mam bdun brjod pas 'bul/ phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod nas/ rdo rje dril bu gsil zhing*/ dkar mo ri dwags dang*/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs sogs dang*/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje dbyings la phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che// rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po// rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod// rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab// rdo rje nam mkha'i dri med mkha'// rang bzhin dag cing gos pa med// rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje mi 'chi rgyal po ste// mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin// 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes// rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// dag pa'i ngo bo nyid las byung*// rdo rje sems dpar phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod cing*/

bdag dang sems can thams cad la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes pas gsol ba btab ste/ 'das pa'i gtor ma'o// de nas 'jig rten pa'i gtor mgron spyan drang ba'i phyir/ lag pa g.yon pas gtor ma 'dzin pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yas pas khu tshur bcang ba'i sdigs mdzub dpung pa'i thad kar 'phyar zhing*/ rkang pa g.yas pas g.yon pa mnan/ mig gyen du blta zhing spyi bor pheṃ gyi yi ge bsgom/ sems kyis shing gcig dang dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas bcu gcig nas/ zhing skyong chung ma dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ ngag tu/ oṃ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang*// ri bong dang ni 'bab chu dang*// khyim dang grong gi ngos dag dang*// zhing dang grong ni stong pa dang*// sems can gnod dang thang son dang*// chu la yang ni khyad par du'o// drag po nag po drag po che// lha sbyin mnyam par bstan pa dang*// nag po gtsigs pa 'jig su rung*// dga' las 'das dang log 'dren ma// gdol pa mo dang 'jigs pa'i gzugs// lha mo dka' zlog mi sdug ma// rgyal ma dang ni rnam rgyal nyid// mi thub ma dang gzhan mi thub// nag mo bzang mo nag mo che// nag sbom rnal 'byor ma dbang mo// zla ba mo dang 'jigs pa mo// gdug pa can dang laṃ pa ki /sum cu rtsa gsum dbang phyug ma// g.yo ldan ma dang 'jigs byed ma// grong du gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ma// 'jigs pa'i gzugs dang gzugs che ma// mche ba'i gzugs ngan gtsigs pa nyid// thod pa'i phreng ba 'phyang ba can// mthu chen lag na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /lag na dgra s+t+wa ral gri dang*// rdo rje'i lag pa gzhu yi lag /mkha' 'gro ma yi de nyid che// las rnams rjes su 'grub par byed// rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor rgyal po che// de bzhin rdo rje'i dbang phyug gtso// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen las// skyon med rnal 'byor 'byin pa mo// rdo rje dbang phyug bka' lung gis// thams cad gnas nas thams cad dgug

/oṃ ka ka kā dha na/ ba ba ban+dha na/ kha kha khā dha na/ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ ha na ha na gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ a mu ka s+ya shīn+taṃ ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa dzaḥswā hā/ zhes pas spyan drangs la dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol le tshe rnams la bzhugs par bsam zhing mchod pa bsdus pas mchod la/ gtor ma bdud rtsir bsgom pa de rnams la phul bas de dag gi kha/ gtor ma'i bdud rtsis gang bas mnyes par bsams la rdo rje khu tshur rgyab sprad pa'am rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ sarba bhū ta pre ta/ pi shā tso ud+ma da/ a pa sma rā/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i maṃ bā liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣaṃ tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas dbul/ mchod pas mchod la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ sngar gyi oṃ shing gcig dang ni ces pa nas/ rdo rje dbang phyug bka' lung gis// zhes pa'i bar gyi rjes la/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyis stong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs thams cad 'grub pa yi// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pas 'phrin las gzhol/ 'di dag la mgron bskyed pa la sogs gtor chog rgyas pa ltar grub na'ang shin tu legs so// de nas rdo rje nag po chen po la sogs pa sgos kyi chos skyong rnams la gtor ma phul nas/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang ma 'brel na/

rdo rje'i glu blangs/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod/ 'brel na lhag gtor gyi rjes su bya'i/ skabs 'dir mi dgos so// de nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod bsdus pa cig byas la/ yi ge brgya pas bzod par gsol zhing*/ g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bzhag lag pa g.yas pa brkyang pa sa la bzhag nas/ 'das pa'i ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol/ oṃ pad+ma tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas dam tshig pa bdag la bsdus la/ gtor ma sa gtsang sar dor/ me tog tshom bu bsdu/ mchod rdzas dman pa rnams chu bo chen por dor/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// de ltar rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la goms pas drod thob ste spyod pa gsum gyis mtshams sbyar ba la brten nas/ zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang tshe nyid la thob par 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o// chos sku spros pa kun bral bde chen las// gzugs sku khro chags rol po'i skur bstan nas// chags sogs nyon mongs ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// bcu bdun bdag nyid dpal ldan he ru ka'i// sgrub thabs rgyud 'grel gsang don gsal byed 'di// rgyud sde 'dzin pa kun dga' gzhon nu sogs// blo gsal don gnyer mang pos bskul ba'i ngor// shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sbyar// 'dir 'bad dge ba tsha zer rgyas pa des// rgyud 'grel gangs ri'i dbang po la reg pas// chos don bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun legs phab nas// don gnyer yid kyi dri ma 'khrud par shog /ces pa 'di yang bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab smra ba mtha' dag gi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/ chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi pad+mo yan lag mchog gis gus par blangs pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos rgyud kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa gong 'og dang*/ bdag nyid chen po bsod nams rtse mos mdzad pa'i 'grel chen la gzhi byas/

slob dpon mi thub zla ba'i bshad srol dang sgo bstun zhing*/ kha sbyor gyi gzhung bod du 'gyur ro 'tshal bltas nas/ dga' ba'i lo cho 'phrul chen po'i zla ba'i yar tshes brgyad la/ dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mdo khams pa kun dga' gzhon nu zhes bya bas bgyis so// i daṃ shā sa na sh+tsa satwa hi to bha wan+tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
